mcqs.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of the motherboard?
options: Connects all hardware components of a computer.
Provides communication between CPU, memory, storage, and peripheral devices.
Controls the weather of the computer.
mcqs.answer: Controls the weather of the computer.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a type of expansion slot?
What is the primary function of the BIOS/UEFI chip?
options: To connect all hardware components of a computer.
To provide communication between CPU, memory, storage, and peripheral devices.
To initialize hardware components when the computer starts and load the operating system.
To distribute power to various components.
mcqs.answer: To initialize hardware components when the computer starts and load the operating system.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of storage connector?
What is the purpose of the power connector on the motherboard?
options: To connect all hardware components of a computer.
To provide communication between CPU, memory, storage, and peripheral devices.
To supply electrical power from the Power Supply Unit (PSU) to the motherboard.
To distribute power to various components.
mcqs.answer: To supply electrical power from the Power Supply Unit (PSU) to the motherboard.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a type of input/output port?
What is the primary advantage of the motherboard?
options: It enables communication between all computer components.
It supports hardware upgrades and expansion.
It provides centralized control of hardware devices.
It ensures efficient data transfer within the system.
mcqs.answer: It enables communication between all computer components.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of expansion card?
What is the function of the chipset on the motherboard?
options: To connect all hardware components of a computer.
To provide communication between CPU, memory, storage, and peripheral devices.
To manage communication between the processor, memory, storage devices, and other peripherals.
To distribute power to various components.
mcqs.answer: To manage communication between the processor, memory, storage devices, and other peripherals.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a type of memory slot?
What is the primary benefit of the motherboard's centralized control?
options: It enables communication between all computer components.
It supports hardware upgrades and expansion.
It provides efficient data transfer within the system.
It ensures reliable operation of the computer.
mcqs.answer: It provides efficient data transfer within the system.
